reasons: You're 6-1 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 16%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 4th of 11 contenders (148.6 points a week).
Your weakest position is TE (5th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 1st in 2028 (title chances about 16%, 27%, 24%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 16% to 21%, and your lineup comes out 5.1 points a week ahead overall. Lamar Jackson adds 3.0 points a week for you today, but Kenneth Walker III is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 6,871, get 6,907), and it helps their lineup too (+2.6 a week), which makes it an easy sell.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 27% and 24% to 27% and 24%.
You have 6 weeks until the trade deadline.
